tests: a symbolic --head reaches merge-preconditions resolved to the staged repository's forty-character sha

dangerousStates.find: const head = resolveHeadFlag(contextDirectory, flags.head as string);

consumesExternalOutput.provenance: Real output of git rev-parse --verify --quiet --end-of-options <ref>^{commit}, the command resolveHeadFlag runs, for HEAD, a mixed-case branch and both lowercased spellings, captured 2026-09-23 in a scratch repository. The named test re-runs all four in its staged repository and compares exit codes and stdout shape with the recorded ones before trusting the gate.
